title: Hespar
extract:
Hespar is a Heavy Scythe weapon that is wielded by Thrax Centurions.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Galeforce Dawn stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (24.00%)
High total damage (280)
High damage × attack speed (360.64)
Very high block angle (65°)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average status chance (28.00%)
Above average crit multiplier (2.20x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average crit chance (24.00%)
High total damage (560)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (65°)
High damage × attack speed (721.28)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average crit multiplier (2.20x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Above average crit chance (24.00%)
Very high total damage (840)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (65°)
High damage × attack speed (1081.92)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average crit multiplier (2.20x)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
Below average disposition (●●●○○ (1.05x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Below average disposition (●●●○○ (1.05x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Below average disposition (●●●○○ (1.05x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Hespar's main blueprint can be acquired from Tier 4 Chrysalith Bounties. The blade blueprint drops from Void Armageddon. The handle blueprint drops from Void Cascade. All components but the main blueprint can be traded.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Bugs
Heavy Attack bug: 1680 × 3 = 5040, is actually 1680 ÷ 3 = 560 per hit.
